questions: Can we move any number of stones from bag A to bag B, including zero or all stones, or is there a minimum positive number required per operation?
Are the bags considered distinguishable for the XOR operation, i.e., does the order B_1, B_2, ..., B_N correspond to the original bag labels after operations?
Is the operation allowed to choose the same bag for both A and B (i.e., move stones from a bag to itself)?
Can we move stones from bag B to bag A in the same operation, or is the direction strictly from A to B as written?
Does the total number of stones remain constant across all bags throughout the operations?
Are negative stone counts allowed in any bag during intermediate steps?
Is the XOR computed over the final stone counts in each bag, or over the multiset of stone counts regardless of bag order?
Can we perform operations sequentially without any other constraints, such as capacity limits on bags?
